question:
다음 흉터를 평가하는 척도 중 환자의 주관적인 평가가 포함된 척도는 무엇인가?  
1) Vancouver Scar Scale (VSS) 
2) Visual Analog Scale (VAS) 
3) MCFONTZL classification system  
4) Stony Brook Scar Evaluation Scale (SBSES) 
5) Patient and Observer Scar Assessment Scale (POSAS)
answer: 5) Patient and Observer Scar Assessment Scale (POSAS)
